description: Get all relationships (connectors) for a given element. `connectors` lists what the element is connected to and how (Realisation, Dependency, Association, etc.), each entry naming its `source` and `dest` ends. For Generalization connectors, `source` is always the specific (child) type and `dest` the general (parent) type — each end also carries a `role` making this explicit without needing to reason about direction. Filter by `connectorType` and `direction` to list an element's direct children (incoming Generalization) or direct parent(s) (outgoing Generalization) without a diagram. Feature links show which specific attribute or operation each end attaches to.

connectorType.description: Filter by connector type (e.g., Realisation, Dependency, Association, InformationFlow, Generalization)

direction.description: Filter direction: outgoing (element is source), incoming (element is target), or both

elementId.description: The Object_ID of the element to get connectors for

name: ea_get_connectors
